assertion.statement: The b-family uses finite locally constant full-B-compatible maps mu_sigma:sigma A to A over L, normalized by mu_1=1, with rational scalar composition cocycle before degree and sign normalization.
assertion.objects: The actual labelled fibre surfaces, rational left B-module, canonical normalizer translates and common Hom field L.
assertion.hypotheses: The all-component integral/rational PEL identification and normalizer-orbit description hold; End^0(A_bar)=B; all geometric homomorphisms among these surfaces are defined over the same finite Galois L.
assertion.quantifiers: One map for every element of Gal(L/Q), then inflation to G_Q; every pair for the scalar composition identity.
assertion.parameter_range: Discriminant210, characteristic zero, non-CM case; full quaternion compatibility.
assertion.uniformity: The maps, source-target convention and field L are fixed for all coefficient primes.
assertion.constants: No conductor or field-degree bound is concluded by this input.
assertion.normalizations: Maps go from sigma A to A; mu_1 is the identity; the rational scalar lattice map commutes with all of B.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Quadratic-field-linear maps alone do not suffice. The discrepancies need not be1, and no coherent descent datum is asserted.
assertion.limit_order: Retain the actual PEL orbit and common Hom field, construct B-linear maps by commensurable lattices, choose on the finite quotient with identity, then inflate and compute the central discrepancies.

use.reason: Use the actual D210 fibre and its canonical normalizer action, not merely a pair of unlabelled isogenous surfaces. The scalar lattice map preserves the rational Hodge structure and full left B-action, and the existing common Hom result places it over L. Choose one map per finite Galois class, with identity at1. The discrepancy commutes with B and lies in B, hence is rational scalar. These are the incoming maps for the later degree/sign normalization; that normalization and cochain splitting remain separate.
use.shared_contract_justification: These locations invoke the identical fixed-family statement. The generic proof specializes through its explicit Section 6 substitution; no field or cochain is exchanged.

supplier.statement: For the actual D210 non-CM full-three fibre, there is a finite choice of B-compatible isogenies mu_sigma:sigma A to A over the same L, with mu_1=1; inflation gives a locally constant family whose composition discrepancies lie in Q*.
